description.value: Tim Hortons is a Canadian quick-service chain with a dine-in, drive-thru, and take-out location in Nanaimo's Uplands area. The menu spans freshly brewed coffee, espresso-based drinks, baked goods including Timbits and donuts, breakfast wraps, soups, and sandwiches. It is a reliably consistent stop for touring cyclists looking for a hot drink, a quick meal, or free WiFi on a long ride.
